name: Telesat Lightspeed

overview.value: Telesat Lightspeed is Telesat's LEO network for connectivity in commercial and military Ka-band. Telesat says the network offers Enterprise and Government service tiers and will be certified to the MEF 3.0 Carrier Ethernet standard.

notes: Telesat's Lightspeed page describes services only; constellation figures not stated on the fetched page. Weekly maintenance 2026-08-06: crossfeed queue candidate from the 2026-08-04 Telesat/MDA Arctic contract item states the funded constellation grew from 156 to 225 satellites (first-party Telesat press release, both this claim and the stored 198 are first-party Telesat statements, so reconcile() scored it both_disputed_queue rather than an automatic upgrade). Stored value stays 198; the 225 figure is recorded as a competing claim under sats_planned.disputed. Queued for Florian: this reads like a straightforward newer-supersedes-older press release (225 is stated as the total after adding 69 satellites to a base of 156, not 198), so the two press releases may not actually agree on the starting count either; worth his read rather than a silent overwrite.
